name: gizza-ai/phone-format
summary: Parse, validate, and format an international phone number.

tool.description: Parse, validate, and format an international phone number. Reports validity, E.164, national & international formats, the country/region, and the number type when derivable.

number.description: The phone number to analyze. May include a +country prefix, e.g. +1 415 555 2671.

region.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 region code (e.g. US, GB, DE) used to interpret a number given without a + prefix.
